ShopBot Index › Beyond UCP › Bot protection

How many stores were refused by bot protection?

In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 1,181 of 2,429 stores we could check had bot protection that refused our crawler (48.6%). The other 1,248 of those 2,429 answered. 994 of the 1,181 refusals were a challenge page. Vendor marks on the 2,429 stores we could check: Cloudflare 1,482, Akamai 105, DataDome 24, HUMAN 6, Imperva 47. A mark is a header or cookie, not a refusal. A refusal of our crawler says nothing about whether shoppers or AI agents can use the site. Left out of the share: 425 stores we couldn't check (the home page was not fetched, or it neither answered nor refused). A refusal is not "no". A published file or profile is a declaration, not proof that agents can buy. ShopBot Index does not test purchases.

Big retailers first (77): AliExpress, Assaí Atacadista, Big C, Bloomingdale's, Castorama, Ceconomy, Coop Cooperative, Coupang, Crocs, Inc., De Bijenkorf, Dick's Sporting Goods, Eataly, EBay, Edeka, Farfetch, Fiverr, Food Lion, Furla, Galeries Lafayette, Globus, GoDaddy, Goodwill Industries, Groupon, H&M, H-E-B, Hamleys, Harrods, Hermès, Hipercor, HMV Retail Ltd., ICA AB, Intersport, John Lewis Partnership, Joom, Jumbo, Just Eat Takeaway, KiK, Kingfisher plc, Kohl's, Le Bon Marché, Leroy Merlin, Levi Strauss & Co., Lindex Group, Lush, Macy's, Marathon Sports, Marui, Meijer, Mercado Libre, METRO Group, Migros, Monoprix, Mothercare, Naspers, Netto Marken-Discount, OXXO, Printemps, Pull&Bear, Repco, REWE Group, Rinascente, Sainsbury's, Saks Fifth Avenue, Sanborns, Saturn, Selfridges, Snapdeal, Staples Inc., Thomann, Trader Joe's, Trendyol, Trivago, Udemy, Upwork, WHSmith, Woolworths Supermarkets and Zara Home.

How we check

We request the home page. Answered means HTTP 200 to 299. Refused means HTTP 401, 403, 429 or 503, or a challenge response (cf-mitigated: challenge) that is not a 2xx success. A store was refused only when no checked website answered and at least one was refused. Vendor marks are observations, not refusals: Cloudflare (cf-ray, or server Cloudflare), Akamai (server Akamai, or cookies _abck, bm_sz or ak_bmsc), DataDome (x-datadome, or a datadome cookie), HUMAN (a _px cookie) and Imperva (incap_ses or x-iinfo). A refusal of our crawler says nothing about whether shoppers or AI agents can use the site. A store counts when at least one of its websites meets the rule. This page counts stores. The Beyond UCP table counts websites, so the two numbers can differ. How we check.

Frequently asked questions

How many stores were refused by bot protection?

In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 1,181 of 2,429 stores we could check had bot protection that refused our crawler (48.6%). The other 1,248 of those 2,429 answered. 994 of the 1,181 refusals were a challenge page. Vendor marks on the 2,429 stores we could check: Cloudflare 1,482, Akamai 105, DataDome 24, HUMAN 6, Imperva 47. A mark is a header or cookie, not a refusal. A refusal of our crawler says nothing about whether shoppers or AI agents can use the site. Left out of the share: 425 stores we couldn't check (the home page was not fetched, or it neither answered nor refused). A refusal is not "no". A published file or profile is a declaration, not proof that agents can buy. ShopBot Index does not test purchases.
